$comment: Meta Model API, Muse Spark 1.3 in Standard mode, checked 2026-10-26 at https://dev.meta.ai/docs/models and /docs/pricing-rate-limits. One model serves both aliases (strong-model, fast-model); reasoning effort is set per role. Muse Spark reads images. Its 1,048,576-token context is capped here at 131072 to bound cost; output is capped at 16384 because reasoning shares the output budget. Prices are USD per million tokens, without cache discounts on the device. The gateway owns concrete IDs and credentials; the engine sends only slot/alias.
